items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: We were playing to a festival in France that had made a bunch of different outdoor stages and Hank Jones was playing and I was at stage ... So after he got off the set I says, “Hey man, Hank, what were you doing with your pedals man?”

ctx.x: Do you feel like you’ve done your best to alleviate that? Because I watched a number of your videos and you were being the master in these situations with college students. It may seem like a small thing against the culture that is happening now but I guess I’m just trying to say that I appreciate that you share your considered opinions.
Some people don’t. Ahmad doesn’t tell. Ahmad is the godfather as far as I’m concerned but he doesn’t tell. Red Garland doesn’t tell. What’s his name — oh man Hank Jones.
